params.prompt:
Create a spectacular 7-second illustrated fighting-game SUPER FINISHER starring Dr. Fade from the reference. This should feel like a legendary character's signature ultimate: theatrical anticipation, whip-fast combo, enormous graphic payoff, confident funny personality. Crisp hand-inked comic outlines, cel shading, exaggerated expressive poses and snappy acceleration. Use the reference for exact character identity and costume, not its background, original text or framing. Preserve his face, glasses, swept-back hair, skin tone, white rolled-sleeve shirt, gray tailored vest and trousers, emerald tie, orange suspenders, boxing gloves and brown shoes.

CHOREOGRAPHY: 0–0.6 seconds: full-body Dr. Fade beside a leather training bag, giving a knowing instructor look. 0.6–1.8: he lowers into a visibly compressed stance, winds back his glove as tight gold energy coils around it; anticipation feels heavy. 1.8–3.2: two whip-fast boxing strikes hammer the bag in a crisp ONE-TWO rhythm, broad curved ink trails and layered gold impact stars accenting each strike. The bag visibly recoils while remaining in frame. 3.2–4.4: a decisive rising glove strike unleashes an OVERSIZED golden boxing-glove-shaped energy burst, a huge jagged black-and-gold starburst and short tapered radial speed strokes. Effects dramatically expand to fill most of the usable composition; Dr. Fade stays fully inside frame and recognizable. A brief impact hold makes the strongest beat land. EXACT title "THE FIRST LESSON" slams into the upper part of the composition on two readable lines, integrated with the impact. 4.4–6.2: gold arcs and sparks settle while the title remains stable; he catches the recoiling bag with a glove and turns with a composed, almost unimpressed teaching gesture, as if this spectacular demonstration was easy. 6.2–7: hold this charismatic full-body finishing tableau. Do not return to a generic idle or shrink the payoff prematurely.

LETTERING: only THE FIRST LESSON. Heavy condensed uppercase comic letters, warm-white/gold fill, thick black outline, small dark offset extrusion, slight upward angle, bold jagged accent behind the title only. Legible, stable spelling, no additional words. Keep title separate from his face. No crowns.

COMPOSITING: fixed camera and one continuous full-body composition, portrait 9:16. Begin character about 55–60% of frame height with enough room for the uppercut, entire bag and all effects. Every body part, prop, title and effect remains inside the frame with at least 5% empty cyan margin on every side. Include the entire bag and its short suspension detail inside the image, no support running beyond an edge. Full body remains visible, both shoes intact, no anatomy changes. Exaggerated poses and expanding effects provide scale, not zooms or closeups. Perfectly flat pure RGB(0,255,255) #00FFFF background throughout. No floor, scenery, gradient, opaque background panel, vignette or backing shadow. All effect strokes end naturally before the border: disconnected tapered speed lines radiate locally from the glove impact, never from image edges. Local white-hot impact core is fine; never replace the full cyan background with a flash. Gold effects have strong ink edges, no cyan/turquoise effects. Preserve costume colors. No camera movement, cuts, cropping or extra characters.

AUDIO: synchronized rising charge, sharp accelerating glove whooshes, two punchy bag hits, a distinct massive final impact, title-slam accent, settling spark tail. Action sound effects only, no music, narration or speech.
